channel.name: Channel
channel.description: 1-11 (1 pan, 2 pan fine, 3 tilt, 4 tilt fine, 5 colour, 6 gobo, 7 shutter, 8 dimmer, 9 pan/tilt speed, 10 function, 11 dim mode)

calibrate.name: Calibrate head
calibrate.description: Calibrate a head (Manual DMX). up / level: the head points straight up / level into the room now. reverse_pan: flip which way pan turns. reset: forget. go_up / go_level / go_left: aim it at straight up / level forward / 45° left as currently calibrated, to adjust or check.

point.name: Point
point.description: up, level, reverse_pan, reset, go_up, go_level or go_left
